name: B10-0431/2025 (S&D) – 10th anniversary of the detention of jailed Swedish publisher Gui Minhai in China
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the 10th anniversary of the detention of jailed Swedish publisher Gui Minhai in China
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It condemns China's detention of Gui Minhai, a Swedish publisher who is also an EU citizen, held since 2015. It asks China to release him, to say where he is held, and to let him see Swedish officials, his family, lawyers and doctors. It also asks Sweden and EU countries to keep pressing for his release, and names other prisoners China should free.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only asks China and EU governments to act.
- **Who it affects:** Gui Minhai, other named prisoners, and EU and Swedish officials dealing with China.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to EU institutions and China's government; no action is required.
